## VaultKeeper.secretExists() method

Check whether a secret exists in the active backend, without retrieving its value, minting a token, or touching the TOFU trust manifest.

**Signature:**

```typescript
secretExists(name: string): Promise<boolean>;
```

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;boolean&gt;

`true` if the secret exists, `false` otherwise.

## Remarks

This is a lightweight precondition check intended to run before any interactive or trust-gating logic (e.g. `exec`<!-- -->'s caller-approval prompt), so a nonexistent secret is reported immediately and unambiguously instead of being masked by an unrelated approval failure — see issue \#69.
